card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_name: Evangelion Test Type-01 Pseudo DMS Phase
card_set: Booster Pack Evangelion: New Theatrical Edition [UE15BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Shinji Ikari> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
This character gains the abilities listed below if you have the required number of face-down cards under it.
・Zero: [During Your Turn] This character gains 5000 BP and 【Impact (3)】.
・Four or more: This character cannot be chosen by your opponent's trigger abilities.
At the end of this character's attack, look at the face-down cards under this character. Reveal up to two cards among them and add them to your hand. If you add two cards to your hand, switch this character to active.
[When Played] Place up to one red <Rei Ayanami> of each required energy from your sideline face down under this character.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule Evangelion: New Theatrical Edition
